name: Grapple Hook
description:
Fire a grapple at a window on a higher floor to tie a climbable escape rope to it.
Equip the grapple hook, put the cursor on the window one or two floors up and left-click. The reticle turns green when the shot is valid.
Ropes are the ammunition: the same number the vanilla escape-rope rule spends for that drop, so a second-floor window costs two ropes (and a nail, if you carry one).
A closed, intact window is smashed by the hook first, exactly as the engine requires before it accepts a rope. Barricaded windows are refused.
